result.topic_en: An addition theorem for elliptic integrals of the first kind applied to a spherical triangle (F a + F b + F c = F π when sin A/sin a = sin B/sin b = sin C/sin c = μ), with numerical logarithmic checks, and a derivation of the addition relation for the inverse function of the integral of dφ/√(A+B cos φ) via differential equations.

items.english: Denoting the integral of dz/√(1−μμ sin²z), taken from z=0, by Fz: if in a spherical triangle whose sides and angles are a, b, c; A, B, C we have sin A/sin a = sin B/sin b = sin C/sin c = μ, then Fa + Fb + Fz = Fπ.
